description: We are ORZU, a team participating in NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026. Our team consists of Fakhriddin Makhmadkhonzoda, a software developer specializing in Go, backend engineering, and system architecture, and Ibrohim Mamadov, who contributes to UI/UX design, presentations, and project development. We're building FireScope, a platform for analyzing NASA satellite fire data. We welcome teammates skilled in Python, data science, geospatial analysis, and scientific research.
